title: astra.registry.operator-act/1
description: The record `state/acts/<jti>.json` the moderation run writes for every operator act it applies (astra-plugins-ops dev/operator-acts-by-passkey-design.md §4.5): the signed body verbatim and the WebAuthn assertion over it, so anyone can re-verify the act under the pinned key for ever, whatever that key's status is now. Exactly these six members: no account id, sign-in time or `amr` (the design's finding 10). Written once and never rewritten; named by its `jti`. `tools/validate.mjs` judges every record against this file, loaded by literal path from this repository, and then verifies its signature (bot/lib/operator-act.mjs, `actRecordProblems`). Inside TRUST-31's hashed set since contract 6.8.0.

body.description: The canonical act body, byte for byte as signed (`astra.registry.operator-act-body/1`).

run.description: The moderation run that applied it.

at.description: When that run applied it: §0.7's whole-second UTC time.
